title: The experience contract: one record of what a person and DCLab did, adoptable by the main product
request: First, store everything users do in DCLab and everything DCLab does in reply, organized and findable, to improve the system and to train the owner's model; adoptable by the main product.
spec: A versioned dclab_core contract for an event and a session: every shared id, a closed vocabulary of kinds, a declared content class per field, credentials never recorded; timeline, redaction and session card as library functions; the main product's own append-only tables read as the same events, with no new table there. Done when every kind round-trips, a field without its class is refused, and a value recorded under a lower class is refused.
plan: Inventory what the studio records (14 mechanisms, no shared session or user id) and read the main product's tables at one commit.
One event shape with every id, a closed vocabulary, a content class per field, refusals in code and in the JSON Schema.
Library functions both hosts run: timeline, redact, session card.
An adapter from the main product's rows, every type mapped or listed with its reason.
Review, read the main product's real rules where the first version guessed, plant faults.

decisions.decision: The contract is an exchange format; each host keeps its stores.
decisions.why: The main product's rules forbid a parallel system and it already has append-only agent events, invocations, decisions and run events.

decisions.decision: A field's class comes from the vocabulary, and redaction reads the vocabulary, not the event's labels.
decisions.why: A copied event skips validation; the vocabulary cannot be relabelled.

decisions.decision: A tool's arguments and result are cell values; an error's message and a refusal's reason are agent text.
decisions.why: Each can quote a table's value, and meta is kept by every export.

decisions.decision: Spend is kept in its own currency and summed by currency.
decisions.why: The main product's gateway writes USD; converting would invent a rate.

decisions.decision: The main product's stage boundaries follow its own rules, read from its code.
decisions.why: The first version guessed a status vocabulary and turned every fold into a finished stage.

change: dclab_core/experience.py (new), dclab_core/adapters/main_product_experience.py (new), dclab_core/adapters/main_product_fields.json (experience tables, vocabularies, payload keys, run rules), dclab_core/contracts.py (registration), dclab_core/schemas.py, dclab_core/schemas/experience_*.json and baselines, dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md, version 0.5.0, docs/guides/CORE_INTEGRATION.md, scripts/core_wheel_check.py, tests/test_core_experience.py.

findings.defect: Cell values and prose passed as meta, which every export keeps.
findings.scenario: A tool result with an e-mail and a salary, an error message quoting a row, a refusal's prose reason: all accepted as meta and kept by a shareable export.
findings.cause: Fields that can hold values were declared meta; meta allowed nesting; counts were not type-checked.
findings.fix: Tool arguments and results are cell values, messages and reasons agent text; meta is flat scalars; a count is a number.

findings.defect: The credential pattern refused ordinary words and missed real credentials.
findings.scenario: 'churn-risk-prediction' refused; a postgresql password, JWTs, hf_ and ASIA keys accepted.
findings.cause: sk- matched inside words; the list was short.
findings.fix: A boundary before each prefix, the common providers, JWTs, bearer in any case, a password in a URL; ids and source scanned too.

findings.defect: The main product's costs were always dropped.
findings.scenario: Its gateway writes USD; cost_eur was None for every row.
findings.fix: cost and currency; the card sums by currency.

findings.defect: The run-status vocabulary was guessed, and wrongly.
findings.scenario: Every cv_fold_ and candidate_ event became a finished stage; 'fail' was dropped.
findings.fix: The main product's _stage_status and live-stage rules, recorded in the fields file.

findings.defect: A thread became one conversation per turn.
findings.scenario: Each model turn is a lead run under the thread.
findings.cause: conversation was the run's own id.
findings.fix: A lead run's conversation is its parent thread.

findings.defect: A failed tool call was recorded as ok.
findings.fix: error with the code; step_rejected's reasons kept.

findings.defect: Model requests vanished without the invocation rows.
findings.scenario: A thread's events alone: no model request.
findings.fix: Skipped only when its invocation row is given.

findings.defect: The kinds the main product cannot fill were not listed.
findings.scenario: visit, draft, feedback, export kinds silently absent.
findings.fix: KINDS_MISSING and TABLES_NOT_READ, with a test that every kind is produced or listed.

findings.defect: The JSON Schema did not tie fields to classes.
findings.scenario: A payload field without its class validated.
findings.fix: Each field requires its class and each class its field.

findings.defect: Times without a zone were accepted and broke the timeline.
findings.scenario: A naive time beside an aware one: TypeError.
findings.fix: A zone is required; times are stored in UTC.

findings.defect: The session lacked the problem and its kind, and never finished on the main product.
The session card was barely tested.
findings.scenario: Outcome or errors replaced by constants passed.
findings.cause: Only an open session was tested.
findings.fix: Built, ran, finished, errors, refused moves and denied tools tested.

findings.scenario: A copied event labelled person text as meta kept it.

findings.defect: The contracts were registered only as a side effect.
findings.scenario: A reader of CONTRACTS saw six of eight.
findings.fix: contracts imports experience at its end.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each of the 18 planted faults in the contract and the adapter fails a test
measurements.result: 18 of 18 caught (8 before the review, 10 after)
limits: The adapter is tested on rows shaped like the main product's, not on its database.

measurements.name: clean install
measurements.gate: the wheel installs in a clean Python 3.12 and reads a main-product row into a session card
measurements.result: make core-wheel-check passed at 0.5.0 with the experience smoke

outcome: The record has one shape both products can read; the studio's writer (19.2) and its emitters (19.3) come next.
lessons: Read the other product's code where a mapping depends on it; a guessed vocabulary is a wrong one.
Classes must follow what a field can hold, not what it usually holds.
A pattern for secrets needs its false positives tested as much as its catches.
Keep amounts in their currency; a conversion is a decision.
Let the vocabulary, not the record, decide what is shared.
risks: Real text refused as a credential.
